title: Geobiology, B.S. (College of Earth and Mineral Sciences)
notes: Pre-2025 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Requirements-for-the-Major Course List (confirmed byte-identical, via direct raw-HTML fetch and diff of all three pages, through the 2023-24 and 2024-25 archives -- same file used for GEOBIO-2023.json and GEOBIO-2024.json). Superseded by the 2025-26 plan's GEOSC 204/GEOSC 310 resequencing and new GEOSC 472B field course (see GEOBIO-2025.json), and by the 2026-27 curriculum's BIOL 234/235W substitution and BIOL 224/225W addition (see GEOBIO-2026.json). Real prereq-fix fallout: this app's course-catalog scrape is a single shared, non-archived snapshot (not versioned per bulletin year), so the same CHEM 110 -> MATH 22 -> MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3 remedial chain documented in GEOBIO-2026.json's own notes applies here too -- all four MATH courses added as explicit early-semester items, same fix, same reasoning. Unlike the 2026 plan, this year's real archived academic plan does NOT have a BIOL 234/BIOL 235W circular-prereq pair: the bulletin's own 'Select 3-4 credits of the following: BIOL 230W, BIOL 240W, MICRB 201' wording is what's actually printed for 2022-23 through 2024-25 (the '(BIOL 234 and BIOL 235W) or (BIOL 244 and BIOL 245W) or MICRB 201' variant only appears starting in the 2026-27 archive), so BIOL 230W is used directly here -- a real, unforced choice, not a substitution. This year's archived plan also lists BIOL 220W (Biology: Populations and Communities, 4cr, prereq only BIOL 110, already scheduled) as an explicit Prescribed Course in Year 2 Spring, matching the 'Requirements for the Major' Course List text that is itself identical across all 5 fetched years 2022-23 through 2026-27 -- GEOBIO-2026.json's own semesters omit BIOL 220W despite its Course List still requiring it every year; not corrected here as GEOBIO-2026.json is outside this file's scope. The archived plan places GEOSC 310 in Year 2 Spring and GEOSC 204 in Year 3 Fall/Spring (the opposite order from the 2025-26/2026-27 plans). The bulletin's real Year 3 Summer term ('GEOSC 472A or BIOL 444', 3cr) is folded into this file's Semester 5 (Junior Fall) instead, matching this app's existing convention of not modeling a distinct summer term in any degree_plans file; GEOSC 472A's own prereq data (concurrent with GEOSC 310) is satisfied trivially since GEOSC 310 is already completed by Semester 2 in this year's real ordering. 'Advanced GEOBI elective' match regex reused verbatim from GEOBIO-2026.json's handbook-verification pass (Penn State Geosciences curriculum sheet, serc.carleton.edu/download/files/8199/penn_state_geobio.pdf) since the Course List's 'Select 12 credits, at least 3 credits from each category' wording is byte-identical across all 5 fetched years -- same documented limitation applies (cross-category 3-credit sub-minimum not separately enforced). The 'BIOL 230W / MICRB 201 / BIOL 240W' item's credits field is set to 4 (BIOL 230W's and BIOL 240W's real value) even though MICRB 201 is actually 3cr -- same single-credits-value-for-a-multi-credit-option-set limitation as elsewhere in this app, noted rather than guessed around.

items.label: BIOL 444 (or GEOSC 472A) -- bulletin's real Summer term, folded in here
